description: Compiled FooTable plugin code implementing pagination components, classes, and methods for table navigation and UI control.

classes.name: F.Pager
classes.description: Represents a page navigation object containing total pages, current page, page size, target page, and direction.

classes.name: F.Paging
classes.description: A component class that manages pagination UI and logic for FooTable, including link creation, navigation, and rendering.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor for Pager, initializes total pages, current page, size, target page, and direction.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies pagination options before UI creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the pagination component and creates UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes pagination UI and resets state.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Performs pagination calculations and slices the data array to show only current page rows.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the pagination UI, including enabling/disabling links and showing/hiding elements.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates pagination UI elements based on current options.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted string with current pagination info, replacing placeholders.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Navigate to the first page.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigate to the previous page.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigate to the next page.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Navigate to the last page.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigate to a specific page number.

methods.name: prevPages
methods.description: Show previous set of page links.

methods.name: nextPages
methods.description: Show next set of page links.

methods.name: pageSize
methods.description: Get or set the number of rows per page.

methods.name: _set
methods.description: Internal method to set current page with event handling.

methods.name: _createLinks
methods.description: Internal method to generate pagination links.

methods.name: _setNavigation
methods.description: Internal method to update navigation link states.

methods.name: _setVisible
methods.description: Internal method to control visible page links.

methods.name: _onPageClicked
methods.description: Event handler for pagination link clicks.
